# Glavas Engineering

> Glavas Engineering provides architectural thermal calculations and façade engineering support for building-envelope projects, including U-value calculations, condensation risk assessments, and Psi- and Chi-value thermal bridge analysis.

Glavas Engineering supports architects, façade engineers, façade contractors, building physicists, energy consultants, structural engineers, developers, manufacturers, and project teams. The work covers new-build and refurbishment projects, individual construction details, façade packages, and wider building-energy calculations, with experience across large-scale commercial projects in the UK.

## Services

- [Thermal bridge calculations](https://glavasengineering.com/services/thermal-bridge-calculations): Psi- and Chi-value calculations for façade junctions, connections, brackets, fixings, balconies, slab edges, window interfaces, and other thermal bridges using 2D Flixo or 3D COMSOL modelling.
- [Condensation risk assessment](https://glavasengineering.com/services/condensation-risk-assessment): Assessment of minimum internal surface temperatures and surface condensation risk at façade and building-envelope junctions.
- [U-value calculations](https://glavasengineering.com/services/u-value-calculations): U-value calculations for solid and framed walls, rainscreen façades, curtain-wall framing, transoms, façade bays, and other building-envelope assemblies.

## Methods and outputs

Depending on the project, assessments may include construction build-up review, material properties, boundary conditions, heat-flow analysis, temperature distributions, minimum internal surface temperatures, U-values, Psi-values, Chi-values, condensation-risk assessment, and technical calculation reports. Tools include Flixo, COMSOL, and BuildDesk. Calculations can include BS EN ISO 10211 methodology where relevant.

## Selected work

- [2D Condensation Risk Assessment](https://glavasengineering.com/work/2d-condensation-risk-assessment): Project-scale assessment of façade junctions using 2D thermal modelling.
- [Solid Wall U-Value & Thermal Bridge Assessment](https://glavasengineering.com/work/solid-wall-u-value-thermal-bridge-assessment): Combined U-, Psi-, and Chi-value assessment of a solid wall assembly.
- [Curtain Wall U-Value & Psi-Value Assessment](https://glavasengineering.com/work/curtain-wall-u-value-psi-value-assessment): Thermal assessment of curtain-wall framing, transoms, and glass-to-frame junctions.
- [3D Thermal Bridge Analysis of a Brise Soleil Connection](https://glavasengineering.com/work/3d-thermal-bridge-analysis-brise-soleil-connection): 3D finite-element analysis of a complex façade connection.
- [3D Condensation Risk Assessment](https://glavasengineering.com/work/3d-condensation-risk-assessment): 3D assessment of a complex junction where two-dimensional modelling is insufficient.
